hero.title: Taste of Madurai
hero.subtitle: A city best explored one bite at a time

intro.heading: Madurai on a Plate
intro.description: From crispy dosas to chilled Jigarthanda, Madurai's food culture is bold, colourful and deeply connected to everyday life.

iconicFoods.name: Jigarthanda
iconicFoods.desc: The legendary chilled drink associated with Madurai.

iconicFoods.name: Kari Dosa
iconicFoods.desc: Crisp dosa loaded with spicy minced mutton filling.

iconicFoods.name: Bun Parotta
iconicFoods.desc: Soft, fluffy parotta variant loved as an evening snack.

iconicFoods.name: Parotta
iconicFoods.desc: Layered flatbread, best paired with salna or curry.

iconicFoods.name: Kothu Parotta
iconicFoods.desc: Shredded parotta stir-fried with egg, meat and spices.

iconicFoods.name: Idiyappam
iconicFoods.desc: Steamed rice noodles, a gentle everyday breakfast staple.

iconicFoods.name: Paruthi Paal
iconicFoods.desc: Traditional cottonseed milk, a Madurai specialty drink.

iconicFoods.name: Madurai Biriyani
iconicFoods.desc: Fragrant, spiced rice dish unique to the region's kitchens.

iconicFoods.name: Ghee Dosa
iconicFoods.desc: A classic dosa brushed generously with ghee for a rich, crisp bite.

iconicFoods.name: Podi Idly
iconicFoods.desc: Soft idlies tossed in spiced lentil podi and sesame oil.

iconicFoods.name: Butter Bun
iconicFoods.desc: A warm, soft bun served with a generous slab of butter.

iconicFoods.name: Halwa
iconicFoods.desc: A glossy, chewy South Indian sweet made with ghee and sugar.

foodStories.name: Jigarthanda
foodStories.quote: The drink that became part of Madurai's identity.
foodStories.story: Made with almond gum, milk, and a scoop of ice cream, this chilled drink has cooled Madurai's streets for over a century.

foodStories.name: Kari Dosa
foodStories.story: A crisp dosa generously topped with spicy minced mutton — a dish that turned street food into a local legend.

foodStories.name: Bun Parotta
foodStories.story: Thicker and fluffier than regular parotta, this evening favourite pairs perfectly with a spicy salna.

foodStories.name: Paruthi Paal
foodStories.quote: A taste passed down through generations.
foodStories.story: Cottonseed milk, sweetened and spiced — a traditional drink increasingly rare outside Madurai's old town.

closing.title: Ready to taste Madurai?
closing.description: Your journey doesn't end at the landmarks. Sometimes the best memories come from the plate.
